channel.description:
How much does a cow cost? What does it cost to raise one? Why is beef so expensive?

The Cattle Ledger answers the money questions behind cattle and beef in short, fact-checked videos. Every number comes from USDA data (Economic Research Service, NASS and AMS): calf and steer prices, ranch costs, beef yields, and where your grocery dollar goes.

New Shorts every day at 6 PM Central, plus a longer Cattle Ledger Weekly every Sunday.
